description: Recorded routing test cases for the ENS AI agent router (challenge CHECK 8). Every case specifies the client request and the expected agent id - or null, meaning no discovered agent is suitable and the router must return an explicit no_suitable_agent response.
expectedAgentsReference: agent ids are the values published in the agent.id ENS text records (see docs/ENS_RECORD_FORMAT.md); null = no suitable agent

cases.request: Can you explain the termination clause in this contract?
What does the limitation of liability clause say about damages?
Who defends us under the indemnification clause if a third party claims IP infringement?
Write a concise premium tagline for our design studio.
Write a product description for our new ceramic coffee cup line.
What is the payment status of our invoices?
How much do we still have outstanding in billing?
What's the weather in Mumbai tomorrow?
Give me a recipe for a hydrangea cocktail syrup.
Refactor this Python function to be async.
